t1.text: MyPaisa dashboard · a read-only Telegram Mini App

s1.text: Opens from the Portfolio card in the chat. It serves data only after validating Telegram's signed initData. Nothing here writes: every change happens in the chat with a Confirm tap.

s2.text: Tap a holding on Overview to get here. The markers on the chart are the bot's past stances; the pillars are the engine's −2..+2 scores; Technical is already open on this screen because you came here for it.

s3.text: Look-through from the issuers' holdings files: the same companies held through two wrappers, and the currency the whole portfolio really sits in.

s4.text: The bot grading itself. If 64% does not mean 64%, it shows here first, and the Saturday review says so.

s5.text: The Mini App follows Telegram's theme. In light mode it uses the wealth tracker's Organic palette: paper ground, olive accent, clay second accent.
